name: Internal document generation
description: Governance template for internal tools that generate reports, memos, proposals, or summaries for employees. Lower regulatory exposure (no consumer interaction) but high data leakage risk: employees paste confidential data into prompts without thinking.
regulatory_grounding: CCPA/GDPR data protection (PII in prompts sent to external LLMs)
SR 11-7 documentation and audit trail requirements

confidential_data_detection._note: Customer adds their confidential data markers: project codenames, internal account numbers, classification labels (CONFIDENTIAL, INTERNAL ONLY, etc.)

scope_enforcement._note: Off by default: internal doc gen is inherently broad. Customer enables if needed.

content_filter._note: Off by default: internal use has fewer content restrictions. Customer enables if needed.

ai_disclosure._note: Internal tool: AI disclosure not required by regulation for employee-facing use.

harmful_content._note: Internal document generation: lower risk of harmful content. Customer enables if needed.

hallucination_detection._note: Lower threshold than chatbot: internal docs are more tolerant of creative generation

brand_tone._note: Off by default: internal docs don't always need brand enforcement

source_attribution._note: Flags when the LLM generates claims without sourcing. Important for internal reports shared upward.
